purpose: Verify different-account, different-server and explicit sign-out boundaries clear unsaved radio state and live completion/error feedback while preserving saved local material.

cases.kind: sign-out cancel retains edits and result

evidenceDetails.differentAccount: A held voice request from the old account fails after the second account is committed. The new editor uses saved defaults, is enabled and has no old live operation/error/completion feedback.
evidenceDetails.differentServer: A completed manual result and unsaved fields clear when the same dummy user ID connects to a second owned HTTP server on another port. Its saved recording remains in the library.
evidenceDetails.signOut: Cancel retains the edited script/mood and completion action. Confirm clears them; signing into the same account again starts from saved defaults and retains the new recording. Enabled preparation remains explicitly paused.
evidenceDetails.sourceInspection: App SessionContent is keyed by normalized connection ID and owns both radio draft state values; changing identity or signing out remounts this owner. Saved local profiles/audio/history are outside that unsaved owner.
evidenceDetails.reportNormalization: A false not-applicable late-failure probe flag was omitted from the server/signout reports; only the account variant exercises that probe.

limitations: Controlled native engineering evidence, not live Jellyfin account or outage acceptance.
This verifies clearing unsaved/live state, not deleting durable local radio profiles, recordings or history. Those remain shared on the same Mac as documented.
The late old-account request is allowed to settle before checking the new editor. This does not claim parallel provider requests are allowed while global work is active.
No VoiceOver, other macOS versions, observed listener session, smaller windows or enlarged zoom covered.
